question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I could make out from my son's voice that he was ____ as his exam did not go well.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sad"** means feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy. (उदास)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt sad after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **"Sad"** is the most appropriate word to describe the feeling when the son's exam did not go well.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill in the blank is **'sad'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Abrogated **(निरस्त): Repeal or do away with (a law, right, or formal agreement).

 
 
• **Example:** The government has abrogated the outdated law.
 
 
 
• **Confused** (उलझन): Unable to think clearly; bewildered.
 
 
• **Example: **She was confused by the complex instructions.
 
 
 
• **Rejected** (अस्वीकृत): Dismissed as inadequate, inappropriate, or not to one's taste.
 
 
• **Example:** His application was rejected due to incomplete information.
